items.statement: Bounded inference about determine whether local bond residuals and cis/trans preference are attributable to torsional conformation or medium, keeping the original six-bond cis validation separate from thermochemistry.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
